memories.content: On 2026-05-01, a young patient died on Mara's hospital shift; she felt nothing could have been done but the loss weighed on her anyway.

Mara judged (2026-05-01) that Dr. Halloran was brutal in the post-loss debrief, picking apart timing as if the team hadn't all been there breaking themselves over the patient; basis: the harsh debrief came right after losing a young patient.

entities.name: Dr. Halloran
entities.description: physician who led the debrief at TGH

memories.content: After the patient's death on 2026-05-01, Mara's colleague Priya found her in the supply room and stood with her without saying anything, which Mara credits as the only reason she stayed upright.
Mara judged (2026-05-01) that TGH is chronically understaffed and that this is a management-made staffing crisis, not a 'vibe'; basis: three nurses quit TGH in the prior two months.

entities.name: TGH
entities.description: the hospital where Mara works as a nurse

memories.content: Mara carries anger about TGH's understaffing that she describes as bigger than any single bad shift, recurring as a throughline beyond tonight's loss.
